rationale: Eggerthella lenta sustains mixed-acid fermentation of glucose and lactate with arginine and cysteine co-utilization. This pattern has proven sustainable over 4 turns. Glucose is primary carbon/energy; lactate, arginine, and cysteine provide secondary carbon and essential nitrogen. Acetate and formate are major fermentation products. Ammonium release balances excess nitrogen from amino acid catabolism.
